payload.summary: COUNTER (codex, quoted). Verdict CHANGE — guard scope too narrow as drafted. Attack: 'A pure helper can become ceremonial if the CSS guard merely looks for strings; it must fail when alignment, reversal, or either animation transform changes independently.' Verdict: 'Keep the arithmetic seam and CSS-text guard, but test the actual contract: symmetric tracks/gap, Player right alignment and reversal, Banker header order, and exact per-seat third-card transform equality with every third-card-emphasis stop.' Why: 'ruleBody() in src/ui/table-shell.test.ts is the established cheap guard pattern. A transform mismatch during concurrent deal-slide and emphasis is precisely the regression text tests catch better than arithmetic alone.' Note EVERY stop — the drafted guard would have compared one keyframe stop and passed a mutation of the other two.
